title: M.I.N.I.O.N (Part M (Wakener))
description: This companion audio to "My Latex Series" is designed to be listened to as an alarm clock. For those of you who are comfortable going into an audio blind, I do highly recommend following my instructions, below, and listening to it for the first time as intended: As an alarm tone to wake you up in the morning, after having listened and fallen asleep to "R.U.B.B.E.R" in the evening before. Ideally, I'd hope you would never listen to this file consciously and instead it remains shared as a private experience between me and your subconscious. Instructions It’s pretty simple, just grab your phone, download the “Sleep” App (or equivalent) and add this file as the alarm 'Tone'. Make sure to select headphones only as the output and set the timer for ten minutes or so before you’d actually like to wake up, put your headphones on and drift off to sleep. Note that I cannot guarantee there won’t be cleanup involved upon waking up; in fact, that's exactly what I plan on happening...
author: Mistress Shibby
